## Addie – Australian Property Research

Search Australian property listings with location and property filters, compare homes, and read dated sales, asking-price history and suburb market data. For example, resolve a suburb, search for homes matching your filters, then compare the relevant listings and their recorded history. The guest endpoint exposes eight read-only tools without sign-in. See the [Addie MCP guide](https://www.addie.house/developers/mcp) for coverage, rate limits and client setup.
